finding.question: What comments by French President Emmanuel Macron about Islamist terrorism were linked to the Pogba retirement allegation, and when and in what context were they made?
finding.summary: Contemporaneous reports linked the allegation to Macron’s description of the murder of teacher Samuel Paty as an Islamist terrorist attack. On October 16, 2020, after the killing, Macron said at Conflans-Sainte-Honorine that Paty had been the victim of an “attentat terroriste islamiste caractérisé,” or a clear Islamist terrorist attack; Paty had shown pupils cartoons of the Prophet Muhammad during a discussion of free speech. Reuters also connected the allegation to Macron’s October 2 speech on “Islamist separatism.” Some reports characterized Macron’s remarks as saying Islam was the source of international terrorism, but the cited official transcript of the October 16 statement describes the attack as Islamist terrorism rather than making that claim.

"Unacceptable, fake news," Pogba, a converted Muslim, posted on Instagram with a screenshot of The Sun's article.

sources.title: Croatia 1-2 France: Les Bleus snatch late victory
sources.snippet: France sprung to life with 15 minutes remaining and substitute Paul Pogba forced a save from Dominik Livaković. Just under three minutes later, Pogba kickstarted the move that led to the winner, spraying a pinpoint pass out to the left for Lucas Digne.

caveats: The 14 October match preceded the allegation, so it does not establish subsequent participation. The evidence cutoff is 26 October 2020, the day the allegation and denial were reported; later matches cannot be used.

findings.question: What comments by French President Emmanuel Macron about Islamist terrorism were linked to the Pogba retirement allegation, and when and in what context were they made?
findings.summary: Contemporaneous reports linked the allegation to Macron’s description of the murder of teacher Samuel Paty as an Islamist terrorist attack. On October 16, 2020, after the killing, Macron said at Conflans-Sainte-Honorine that Paty had been the victim of an “attentat terroriste islamiste caractérisé,” or a clear Islamist terrorist attack; Paty had shown pupils cartoons of the Prophet Muhammad during a discussion of free speech. Reuters also connected the allegation to Macron’s October 2 speech on “Islamist separatism.” Some reports characterized Macron’s remarks as saying Islam was the source of international terrorism, but the cited official transcript of the October 16 statement describes the attack as Islamist terrorism rather than making that claim.

sources.title: Paul Pogba denies reports he has quit French national team over Emmanuel Macron’s terrorism comments
sources.snippet: Reports in the Middle East claimed Pogba had stepped down from national duties over Macron’s description of the murder of French school teacher Samuel Paty as an “Islamic terrorist attack”.

sources.title: Déclaration du Président Emmanuel Macron suite à l’attentat de Conflans-Sainte-Honorine
sources.snippet: Ce vendredi 16 octobre, le Président Emmanuel Macron s'est rendu à Conflans-Sainte-Honorine suite à l'attentat perpétré contre un professeur.... Notre compatriote a été lâchement attaqué, a été la victime d'un attentat terroriste islamiste caractérisé.

sources.title: Paul Pogba denies reports he has quit French national team over President Emmanuel Macron’s terrorism comments
sources.snippet: French footballer Paul Pogba has slammed reports claiming that the star had quit the national team as a mark of protest after the recent comments of the French president Emmanuel Macron on Islam being the source of international terrorism.

caveats: Contemporaneous accounts described the remarks differently; the official October 16 transcript supports the specific description of Paty’s murder, not the broader wording attributing international terrorism to Islam.

findings.question: Which club did Paul Pogba play for, and was he part of the French national team, when the retirement allegation circulated and at the latest verifiable date?
findings.summary: Pogba played for Manchester United and was part of the France national team when the allegation circulated in October 2020. UEFA records him appearing for France against Croatia on October 14, and Manchester United named him in its squad on October 17. On October 26, the latest date permitted by the evidence cutoff, the club said he remained fully committed to playing for France.

sources.title: Man United midfielder Pogba 'angry, appalled' by media treatment
sources.snippet: Manchester United released a statement later Monday in support of Pogba, saying: "Paul supports respect for his own religion and all religions, and is against any form of violence. These stories are totally unfounded. Paul is fully committed to playing for his country."

caveats: The latest status is as of the October 26, 2020 evidence cutoff, not a later assessment of his career.
